verdict.rationale: Jules lets users create API keys from the web app's Settings page, capped at 3 keys at a time, which an agent or workflow can use to drive the Jules API. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, permission-restricted or otherwise least-privilege, so only the basic credential-issuance part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: per-key scopes/permissions, least-privilege or repo-restricted credentials, expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.
